Criminalises same-sex conduct with custodial and lashing penalties, no discrimination protection, restrictive UN posture, pervasive homophobia, but no trans-specific offence, no death penalty, rare enforcement, and guidance reporting tourists generally welcome; thin record extrapolates structurally.

Statutory protections exist but enforcement fails: documented document-mismatch service denial, commonplace discrimination with no meaningful response, trans detainee held in forced isolation with strip searches, extremely low social acceptance; no criminalisation or police campaign, Pride now protected.

Operating protections: gender-identity discrimination law with 2024 damages award, 2025 hate-crime law, lived-gender custody placement, care access. Residual friction from organised exclusionary campaigns and uneven state coverage, without border, facility or criminalisation exposure.
